items.author: Bryan Harrington
items.text: I can’t say enough great things about my experience with Direct Connect Flight Academy in completing their ATP-CTP course. Definitely one of the best one of these courses available in my opinion, especially if you are using GI Bill and want to save a little time and money. I found out about them at RTAG. They are the only CTP course I could find that offered the classroom portion online, reducing the amount of time away from home and the money spent on hotels. They made the whole process of completing the course easy and as stress free as possible. Their instructors are true professionals and are actively working in the roles that they are instructing in. They definitely exceeded my expectations, especially for a smaller flight academy. 10/10 recommend!

items.author: Marty Stern
items.text: I had an amazing experience with DCFA during my ATP-CTP course. The instructors, Cody and Ben, ensured the course was both interesting and fun. Moreover, the online ground portion saved both travel time and costs. I feel like I took a major leap forward in my aviation skills and could not recommend this group highly enough. Be prepared to work, but also have a great time!

items.author: Doug Klotz
items.text: I was actually sad the training ended!  Great training, great experience, great team!  Frank worked with me to curate a program that met both our needs, Cody was excellent covering the comprehensive ground material.  I left DCFA with a feeling that my pilot knowledge and skills took a big step forward.  Thank you DCFA!

items.author: Logan Howard
items.text:
Training at DCFA Flight School was an incredible journey from start to finish. The instructors are knowledgeable, patient, and truly invested in every student’s success. The curriculum is well-structured, balancing ground school and flight training in a way that keeps you progressing with confidence.
The fleet is well-maintained and reliable, and the school operates with a high standard of professionalism and safety. What really sets DCFA apart is the supportive community—everyone from the front desk staff to the senior instructors creates a positive environment that makes learning enjoyable and motivating.
Flying in Colorado is also a huge bonus. The scenery is absolutely stunning, and the diverse weather and terrain make you a more well-rounded and capable pilot. It’s a beautiful and challenging place to train that really sharpens your skills.
On top of that, I made great friendships during my time here. DCFA has a collaborative, tight-knit group of students and instructors that makes the whole experience even more rewarding. Whether you’re studying, flying, or just hanging out, there’s always someone to learn from or fly with.
Whether you’re starting your private pilot training or working toward a professional aviation career, DCFA is the place to do it. I couldn’t be happier with my experience here and highly recommend it to anyone serious about flying!

items.author: Warren D
items.text: Great flight school for those who aspire to be a professional pilot! The owners genuinely care about the success of the students and staff. Aircraft are very well maintained by an on sight A&P. Training is designed to make you successful in the professional aviation world and is focused, realistic, demanding and very beneficial! I am a veteran with 20 years of helicopter experience and would highly recommend this school to any serious, aspiring airplane pilots! Additionally they are a 141 school and have experience helping vets use their GI Bill and VRNE benefits!

items.author: Drew Gauwitz
items.text: The owners are very kind and professional. They will work with you to help reach your goals. I highly recommend checking them out!
